mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_notification ( kind, role_seq, plant_seq, ref_type, ref_no, title, body, level, occurred_at, created_by ) SELECT #{kind}, #{roleSeq}, #{plantSeq}, #{refType}, #{refNo}, #{title}, #{body}, COALESCE(#{level}, 'INFO'), COALESCE(#{occurredAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy} ON CONFLICT (kind, ref_type, ref_no) WHERE closed_yn = 'N' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_notification n LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = n.role_seq LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = n.plant_seq

SELECT n.*, r.role_id, r.role_name, pl.plant_name, NULL::boolean AS read_yn, NULL::int AS aging_days FROM tb_notification n LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = n.role_seq LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = n.plant_seq WHERE n.notification_seq = #{notificationSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_notification_read (notification_seq, user_seq) VALUES (#{notificationSeq}, #{userSeq}) ON CONFLICT (notification_seq, user_seq) DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT 'PO_OVERDUE' AS kind, r.role_seq AS role_seq, o.plant_seq AS plant_seq, 'PUR_ORDER' AS ref_type, o.order_no AS ref_no,
o.order_no || ' 납기 초과 ' || (CURRENT_DATE - o.due_date) || '일' AS title, COALESCE(pt.partner_name, '') || ' · 미입고 ' || (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.order_qty - COALESCE(l.received_qty, 0)), 0)::int FROM tb_purchase_order_line l WHERE l.order_seq = o.order_seq) || '개' AS body, 'WARN' AS level, (o.due_date + 1)::timestamp AS occurred_at FROM tb_purchase_order o LEFT JOIN tb_partner pt ON pt.partner_seq = o.supplier_seq JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = 'PURCHASER' WHERE o.order_status IN ('ISSUED','PARTIAL') AND o.due_date IS NOT NULL AND o.due_date < CURRENT_DATE

SELECT 'TRANSIT_STUCK' AS kind, r.role_seq AS role_seq, o.plant_seq AS plant_seq, 'WAYBILL' AS ref_type, w.waybill_no AS ref_no, w.waybill_no || ' 운송중 ' || DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - b.handed_over_at)::int || '일' AS title, COALESCE(cr.courier_name, w.courier_code) || ' · ' || o.outbound_no || ' · ' || (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bl.packed_qty), 0)::int FROM tb_pack_box_line bl WHERE bl.box_seq = b.box_seq) || '개가 떠 있습니다' AS body, 'WARN' AS level, b.handed_over_at AS occurred_at FROM tb_waybill w JOIN tb_pack_box b ON b.box_seq = w.box_seq JOIN tb_outbound o ON o.outbound_seq = b.outbound_seq LEFT JOIN tb_courier cr ON cr.courier_code = w.courier_code JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = 'CS_VIEWER' WHERE w.waybill_status = 'ISSUED' AND w.delivery_status NOT IN ('DELIVERED','LOST') AND b.handed_over_at IS NOT NULL AND b.handed_over_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{days} || ' days')::interval

SELECT 'CHAIN_BROKEN' AS kind, r.role_seq AS role_seq, o.plant_seq AS plant_seq, 'CHAIN' AS ref_type, o.outbound_no AS ref_no, o.outbound_no || ' 수량이 맞지 않습니다' AS title, k.sku_id || ' · 지시 ' || ol.instructed_qty || ' 집음 ' || ol.picked_qty || ' 검수 ' || ol.inspected_qty || ' 담음 ' || COALESCE(pk.packed, 0) AS body, 'ALERT' AS level, COALESCE(o.shipped_at, o.instructed_at) AS occurred_at FROM tb_outbound o JOIN tb_outbound_line ol ON ol.outbound_seq = o.outbound_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = ol.sku_seq LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bl.packed_qty), 0)::int AS packed FROM tb_pack_box_line bl JOIN tb_pack_box b2 ON b2.box_seq = bl.box_seq WHERE bl.line_seq = ol.line_seq AND b2.outbound_seq = o.outbound_seq ) pk ON TRUE JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = 'CENTER_MGR' WHERE ( (o.outbound_status IN ('PICKED','PACKING','PACKED','SHIPPED') AND ol.instructed_qty <> ol.picked_qty + ol.shortage_qty) OR (o.outbound_status IN ('PACKED','SHIPPED') AND ol.inspected_qty <> ol.picked_qty) OR (o.outbound_status IN ('PACKED','SHIPPED') AND COALESCE(pk.packed, 0) <> ol.inspected_qty) )

SELECT 'APPROVAL_WAIT' AS kind, r.role_seq AS role_seq, x.plant_seq AS plant_seq, x.ref_type AS ref_type, x.ref_no AS ref_no, x.ref_no || ' 결재 대기 ' || DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - x.requested_at)::int || '일' AS title, x.kind_label || ' · ' || COALESCE(u.user_name, x.requested_by) || ' 올림' AS body, CASE WHEN x.requested_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 'WARN' ELSE 'INFO' END AS level, x.requested_at AS occurred_at FROM ( SELECT 'PUR_REQUEST' AS ref_type, '구매요청' AS kind_label, pr.request_no AS ref_no, pr.plant_seq, pr.requested_by, pr.requested_at, 'PURCHASER' AS approve_role FROM tb_purchase_request pr WHERE pr.request_status = 'REQUESTED' UNION ALL SELECT 'INV_ADJUST', '재고조정', a.adjust_no, w.plant_seq, a.requested_by, a.requested_at, 'CENTER_MGR' FROM tb_stock_adjust a LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = a.warehouse_seq WHERE a.adjust_status = 'REQUESTED' UNION ALL SELECT 'INB_CORRECT', '입고정정', ic.correct_no, i.plant_seq, ic.requested_by, ic.requested_at, 'CENTER_MGR' FROM tb_inbound_correct ic LEFT JOIN tb_inbound i ON i.inbound_seq = ic.inbound_seq WHERE ic.correct_status = 'REQUESTED' ) x JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = x.approve_role LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = x.requested_by

SELECT 'ORDER_UNMAPPED' AS kind, r.role_seq AS role_seq, NULL::bigint AS plant_seq, 'ORDER' AS ref_type, o.order_no AS ref_no, o.order_no || ' 에 SKU 가 안 붙은 품목이 ' || COUNT(*)::int || '개 있습니다' AS title, COALESCE(ch.channel_name, '') || ' · ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(l.ext_product_code, '?'), ', ') AS body, 'WARN' AS level, o.ordered_at AS occurred_at FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.order_seq = o.order_seq LEFT JOIN tb_channel ch ON ch.channel_seq = o.channel_seq JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = 'ORDER_MGR' WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELED','SHIPPED') AND l.sku_seq IS NULL AND l.line_status <> 'CANCELED' GROUP BY o.order_no, o.ordered_at, ch.channel_name, r.role_seq

SELECT 'ALLOC_SHORT' AS kind, r.role_seq AS role_seq, NULL::bigint AS plant_seq, 'ORDER' AS ref_type, o.order_no AS ref_no, o.order_no || ' 재고 부족 — ' || COUNT(*)::int || '개 품목' AS title, COALESCE(ch.channel_name, '') || ' · ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT k.sku_id, ', ') AS body, 'WARN' AS level, o.ordered_at AS occurred_at FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.order_seq = o.order_seq JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = l.sku_seq LEFT JOIN tb_channel ch ON ch.channel_seq = o.channel_seq JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = 'ORDER_MGR' WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELED','SHIPPED') AND l.line_status = 'SHORTAGE' GROUP BY o.order_no, o.ordered_at, ch.channel_name, r.role_seq

SELECT 'INBOUND_UNCLOSED' AS kind, r.role_seq AS role_seq, i.plant_seq AS plant_seq, 'INBOUND' AS ref_type, i.inbound_no AS ref_no, i.inbound_no || ' 적치 끝 · 입고완료 대기' AS title,
CASE WHEN pt.partner_name IS NULL THEN '' ELSE pt.partner_name || ' · ' END || '적치 ' || COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.putaway_qty)::int FROM tb_inbound_line l WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq), 0) || '개가 아직 재고가 아닙니다' AS body, 'WARN' AS level, (SELECT MAX(p.putaway_at) FROM tb_inbound_putaway p JOIN tb_inbound_line l ON l.line_seq = p.line_seq WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq) AS occurred_at FROM tb_inbound i LEFT JOIN tb_partner pt ON pt.partner_seq = i.supplier_seq JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = 'CENTER_MGR' WHERE i.inbound_status = 'PUTAWAY' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_inbound_line l WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq AND COALESCE(l.putaway_qty, 0) > 0)
AND (i.over_approved_by IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.received_qty) FROM tb_inbound_line l WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq), 0) <= COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.planned_qty) FROM tb_inbound_line l WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq), 0))
